text: An adjunction L ⊣ R between categories C and D is characterized by:
choices: L and R being inverse functors
A natural bijection Hom_D(LA, B) ≅ Hom_C(A, RB)
L preserving limits and R preserving colimits
explanation: L ⊣ R iff there is a natural bijection between hom-sets, with L left adjoint and R right adjoint.
